Passenger Arrested for Attempting to Open Aircraft Emergency Exit Mid-Flight

A passenger on a Kuala Lumpur to Kochi flight was arrested mid-air for attempting to open an emergency exit. The First Information Report (FIR) states the individual tried to force open the door, damaged a window panel, and threatened fellow passengers, thereby endangering everyone on board. The incident occurred on a flight bound for Kochi. The passenger was subsequently detained.
